title: GLIDE: Towards Photorealistic Image Generation and Editing with Text-Guided Diffusion Models
property: overall prompt match (image and caption similarity)
reads: Noised CLIP reads the noised 64x64 pixel image x_t and timestep t through a ViT with 4x4 patches, and the full caption through its text encoder
trained_on: Noised ViT-L CLIP with the original CLIP contrastive objective on a 50-50 mixture of the CLIP and DALL-E datasets, 390K iterations at batch 32K, using the base model's noise schedule, then 30K fine-tuning iterations on broader internet images
gradient_enters: Added to the reverse-process mean as s times Sigma times grad_x_t of f(x_t) dot g(c), at CLIP guidance scale 2.0, with 250 evaluation steps and no printed normalisation, cap or step window
unseen: no: CLIP guidance is scored on MS-COCO validation prompts and no concept or category is held out from noised CLIP training
headline: Human Elo (pairwise preference, higher better) on MS-COCO validation prompts at 256x256 with GLIDE's 3.5 billion parameter model: noised CLIP guidance at scale 2.0 scores -73.2 photorealism and 29.3 caption match, against 82.7 and 110.9 for classifier-free guidance at scale 3.0 and -88.6 and -106.2 unguided
copy_or_avoid: Copy timestep-aware training on the noisy input and independent human evaluation; avoid treating a higher CLIP-style score as better composition, and do not cite it for unseen concepts (inferred)
model: GLIDE (3.5B parameter 64x64 pixel diffusion plus 256x256 upsampler)
why_added: guides with a CLIP retrained on noisy inputs; named by Universal Guidance, p. 2
